name: aura-asus-desktop
description: React frontend with a Python desktop shell for the local-first AURA ASUS assistant.

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,python "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && python desktop_launcher.py"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run typecheck && vite build && py -3.14 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onefile --noconsole --name "AURA ASUS" --icon "%CD%\public\assets\aura-app-icon.ico" --distpath "C:\PROJECT\AURA ASUS EXE" --workpath "build-webview" --specpath "build-webview" --add-data "%CD%\dist;dist" --add-data "%CD%\tools\piper;tools\piper" --add-data "%CD%\voices;voices" --collect-submodules backend desktop_launcher.py
scripts.desktop:build:global: npm run typecheck && vite build && py -3.14 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onefile --noconsole --name "AURA" --icon "%CD%\public\assets\aura-app-icon.ico" --distpath "C:\PROJECT\AURA GLOBAL EXE" --workpath "build-global" --specpath "build-global" --add-data "%CD%\dist;dist" --add-data "%CD%\tools\piper;tools\piper" --add-data "%CD%\voices;voices" --collect-submodules backend desktop_launcher.py
